item.title: Abdul El-Sayed rebranded ‘Medicare For All’ to get Trump’s attention. It worked
item.description: Could a shiny gold card change President Trump’s mind about Medicare for All? He believes in the initiative so much, he’s even willing to rebrand it to an unlikely name.

item.title: How fast food workers are being ranked and reprimanded with AI
item.description: From customer interactions to driving speeds, restaurant chains like Burger King and Domino’s are increasingly using AI to monitor workers on the job. Corrin Kearney had been delivering pizzas for a Domino’s in North Texas for a few months when their store asked them to install a new app on their phone and keep it open during their shift. Soon, Kearney learned the app was tracking and scoring every delivery route they drove, with the results displayed on a leaderboard back at the store for the whole crew to see....
